kevin: Heads up — profiling from yesterday's canary shows a sustained long-query tail when short-path tenants spike.
maya: saw that. KV warmup looks fine, but batching delays increase for long sequences after ~120s of short bursts.
anish: summary of traces? can you paste perf flame?
kevin: paste: 
```
flame: kernel_select -> 42%
       batching_wait -> 18%
       kv_lookup -> 12%
       kernel_handoff -> 8ms median per swap
```
maya: note the hot path: kernel-selection loop picks fastpath when batch_token_count < threshold — this biases towards short sequences and starves long ones under mixed load.
anish: proposed: spin-allocator that keeps a small short-path quota but uses exponential backoff + hysteresis on token thresholds so we don't flip-flop.
kevin: sketch config:
```yaml
spin_allocator:
  short_quota: 0.15    # fraction of tokens reserved for short sequences
  hysteresis_ms: 50
  backoff_scale: 1.5
  min_tokens: 32
```
maya: also want KV-awareness: if kv_hit_rate > 0.8 then reduce short_quota by 0.5x temporarily (high KV hit makes short-path cheaper).
infra-bot: perf-test scheduled: microbench/mixed_seq_60-40 with kernel-handoff patch, 3 runs.
anish: metrics to watch: p99 latency (long/short separate), batch formation delay, token-credit-imbalance.
kevin: one caveat — kernel handoff penalty ~8ms when swapping execution kernels mid-batch. need small token-guard to avoid thrash.
maya: alternative: batch-anchoring — group requests by predicted path for first N tokens then allow mix. less kernel swapping but may increase short-path tail slightly.
anish: let's run both: spin-allocator + token-guard vs batch-anchoring. A/B on same machine type.
kevin: I'll land experimental flags behind rollout: runtime.feature.spin_allocator and runtime.feature.batch_anchor
maya: will add telemetry tags: experiment=spin_vs_anchor, group, kv_hit_rate, seq_len_bucket.
anish: can someone add a tiny eval set with noisy short bursts? i can create one.
kevin: created sample: /perf/bench/mixed_bursts_shorty.json
maya: infra-bot: canary started at 2026-03-18T15:12Z
infra-bot: canary: run 1 complete. spin_allocator: p99_long +4% vs baseline. batch_anchor: p99_long -3%. short p50 improved both.
anish: interesting — kernel handoff cost seems dominant in spin_allocator. maybe reduce handoff frequency by coalescing kernel choices per epoch.
kevin: next steps: 1) tune hysteresis_ms -> try 100/200, 2) add token-guard margin proportional to estimated kernel_swap_cost, 3) rerun 5x.
maya: I'll dashboard those KPIs under /dash/eng-runtime/queue-fairness
anish: ack. thanks. :thumbsup:
kevin: filing follow-up ticket: RD-7843 with config matrix and raw traces.
maya: looping in product infra for SLA impact: @sasha fyi
sasha: thanks, will watch. can you notify if p99_long > +10%?
kevin: will do.
